problem_type: Model-resolution failure during polling surfaces as a raw recoverable error instead of an honest terminal failure
symptom: While a task is being polled, if the model was removed or its credential became invalid, findExecutableModel throws and the raw error bubbles out of fetchTaskResult; the renderer treats a thrown query error as recoverable, keeps retrying for the free-grace window, then parks the task as recoverable — the message never points at the root cause and the condition can never heal by retrying.
direct_cause: executeTaskQuery resolved the model outside any guard, unlike rebuildCachedTaskFromPayload which wraps the same call and falls back to honest diagnostics.
class_root: Permanent resolution failures (model gone / credential invalid) must convert to terminal failed results at the query boundary; only transient network errors may remain recoverable throws.
affected_population: Tasks still polling when their model gets removed or its credential expires
internal_only_reason: Internal vendor task-result boundary; no external format change.
invariants: A model-resolution throw inside executeTaskQuery returns a failed result with tasks.modelUnresolvable instead of rejecting.
Transient executeProfileOperation errors keep their existing recoverable-throw semantics.
generality_proof: The guard sits at the single model-resolution point shared by cached and rebuilt task queries, so both admission paths get the same honest terminal behavior.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Convert permanent model-resolution failures to terminal failed results.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Already guards the same findExecutableModel call and returns null to fall through to honest cache-miss diagnostics; the reference pattern this fix mirrors.
Transient query failures intentionally remain recoverable per the fetchTaskResult doctrine comment; unchanged.

recurrence.reason: A single unguarded resolution call; the sibling path already guarded it.
same_class_scan: Checked executeProfileOperation call sites in this file: transient-error semantics preserved on purpose.

legacy_paths.rationale: No legacy path removed; a guard was added around resolution.

residual_risks: A transient catalog read failure that throws inside findExecutableModel would now surface as terminal instead of recoverable; catalog reads are local-file and deterministic, so this is accepted.

invariant_owner_layer.note: The query boundary owns result classification; the regression pins resolution failures becoming honest terminal results.
